Ganesh Prasad Gupta vs The State Of Jharkhand on 9 May, 2024 
Author: Rajesh Kumar
Bench: Rajesh Kumar
 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
 W.P. (Cr.) No.1085 of 2023
 ----
Ganesh Prasad Gupta .... .... Petitioner Versus The State of Jharkhand .... .... Respondent
----
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar 
---- 
For the Petitioner :Mr. Sanjay Kr. Pandey, Adv. For the Resp.-State :Mr. D.P. Mishra, Aag-I
----
06/Dated:9th May, 2024
1 . Heard learned counsel for the parties. 
2.  The present criminal writ petition has been filed for following reliefs:-
"That, the petitioner begs to move before this Hon'ble Court for issuance of an appropriate writ/writs, order/orders, direction/directions or a writ in the nature of Certiorari for quashing/set-aside the order dated 19.09.2023 passed by the learned Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Garhwa in Garhwa P.S. Case No.607 of 2022,
instituted under Sections 413 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 7 of the Essential Commodities Act whereby and whereunder the learned court has pleased to reject the prayer of the petitioner which is filed for release of food grains i.e. wheat and rice (wheat 35 bags containing 50-55 Kg. per bag and rice 38 bags containing 55-60 Kg. per bag) which is lying in the open place without taking any place for safety of the food grains which is going to wastage. Now the case is pending in the court of the learned Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate at Garhwa. 
AND Be further pleased to release the seized food grains i.e. wheat and rice in favour of the petitioner." 
Ganesh Prasad Gupta vs The State Of Jharkhand on 9 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126101181/
1 3. It appears that an F.I.R. has been lodged being Garhwa P.S. Case No.607 of 2022. The allegation has been made that the grains meant for public distribution system (PDS) has been found in possession of this petitioner. Prayer for release of the same has been made which has been dismissed vide order dated 19.09.2023 passed in Garhwa P.S. Case No.607 of 2022 by the SDJM.,
Garhwa, which has been impugned in the present writ petition. 
4. Considering the fact that it is consumable item, the court below is directed to release the same after taking the evidentiary value. The court below is at liberty to impose any other condition. 
5. With above observation and direction, the present criminal writ petition stands disposed of. 
(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Shahid/-
